title: 19594 - 19594/P3138/012600
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
commonCauses: Intake Manifold Runner Control Basic Setting not performed
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Intake Manifold Runner Control faulty
stepByStepSolution: Perform Intake Manifold Runner Control Basic Setting
Kontrol edin: /Repair Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Intake Manifold Runner Control
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Intake Manifold Runner Control
technicalNotes:
When found in Engine: 2.0l TFSI, perform Basic Setting.
Kontrol edin:  Audi TSB 24-08-10  or  2016868 (NAR) North American Region vehicles only. Audi TPI 2016868 covers the revised part numbers.
Kontrol edin:  VW TSB 01-08-12  or  2018402 (NAR) North American Region vehicles only. VW TPI 2027457 covers the revised part numbers.
Kontrol edin:  Engine Control Module Software Version, if necessary perform Update.
Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Intake Manifold Runner (V157) with updated part.
Additional information may be found by searching RVU 24M2 / O3 (Exp. date November 30, 2011) or calling the VW dealer and checking the VIN.
When found on Direct Injection engines, such as the 2.0l TFSI, in combination with system too lean or similar faults indicating a vacuum leak diagnose them because "Regulation Deviation " may be the result of a vacuum leak.
